हिल् {c6c} P. (हिलति) To sport
amorously, wanton, dally, express
amorous desire.

1 A wave, billow.
--2 The
musical mode called Hindola.
--3 A
caprice, whim.
--4 A kind of coitus.

हिल्वलाः f. pl. N. of five small
stars in the head of the lunar
mansion called मृगशिरस्.

हीलुकं A kind of rum (distilled
from molasses).
